programme.desc: S5E1 - Michael Symon starts at his very own restaurant where he enjoys a pastrami beef rib; his grandfather's recipe for scratch-made spaetzle and spicy sauerkraut; a beer-marinated pork loin sandwich; chicken and waffles get a burger makeover. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Barbecue Boss of All Sandwiches
programme.desc: S6E3 - Michael Symon devours a meaty stacked sandwich and a beefy ballpark dog; a gas station-turned-burger joint serves a fried apple and brie cheeseburger; homemade deep-fried sausage and Cajun crawfish enchiladas. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Bayou Barbecue and Saucy Skillets
programme.desc: S6E5 - Michael Symon starts in Las Vegas with a skillet full of pork belly chili and a mega-pancake; mac and cheese studded with crawfish, alligator andouille sausage and shrimp; an umami burger built for every craving. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Far East Meats Wild West
programme.desc: S6E7 - Michael Symon devours towering burgers piled with spicy Korean pork bulgogi and juicy pork belly pastrami; a modern-day sloppy joe is loaded with burnt brisket ends; lamb-chili tacos and cheesy shawarma nachos. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Burgers, Brew & 'Que - Sweet Treats and Savory Meats
programme.desc: S4E8 - Michael Symon starts in Boston with triple-processed pork belly that's cured, brined and smoked; tender braised lamb shoulder amps up a traditional breakfast hash; fresh, local cinnamon rolls as buns for an insanely sweet and savory burger. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Paris
programme.desc: S1E2 - Steak frites and the croque monsieur; from baked croissant and baguettes to sweet macarons and savory crêpes. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Tokyo
programme.desc: S1E9 - Edible icons such as sushi and tempura in Tokyo, Japan, where the food is spectacular and delicious to all. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Charleston
programme.desc: S3E15 - Andrew explores the iconic dishes of Charleston, S.C.; known for its low country culinary style and high-class hospitality, this charming city offers coastal classics like shrimp and grits, she-crab soup and barbecue. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Oaxaca
programme.desc: S5E18 - Andrew Zimmern explores regional specialties in Oaxaca, Mexico from complex mole negro sauce over Mayan-era tamales and crispy tortilla with pork lard to egg bread dunked in hot chocolate. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Cartagena
programme.desc: S6E15 - Andrew Zimmern shows off the tempting flavors of Cartagena, Colombia; from fried fish and sizzling egg arepas to bedroom-boosting fruits and seafood stews, the taste of the coast infuses every bite. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations - Dominican Republic
programme.desc: S6E21 - Andrew Zimmern takes a culinary tour of the Dominican Republic, sampling its meaty, tropical dishes, from whole roast pig to crispy, Lebanese-inspired fried dough pockets. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Sweet Bay Area Bites
programme.desc: S6E10 - Discovering unique sweets in the San Francisco Bay Area; why people are raving about the pies at Pietisserie in Oakland; a ruby red beet pie that brims with roasted beets, mashed and mixed into a creamy sweet filling. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Southern
programme.desc: S1E11 - A ladylike lady Baltimore cake; a trendy restaurant re-invents regional classic desserts; the cutest pies with surprising fillings; heavenly layer cakes. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Sweet Americana
programme.desc: S3E5 - Visiting Mojo Monkey, Brooklyn Farmacy, Chicago Diner and Teaspoon Bakeshop. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Sweet Peanut
programme.desc: S3E8 - Sweet shops offer their own takes on peanut butter. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Wild West Sweets
programme.desc: S3E9 - Full service cereal bar and bakery; cookie art; handcrafted sweets; experimental ice creams. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Unique Sweets - Global Sweets
programme.desc: S3E10 - Bakery shares family traditions with their customers; Taiwanese baked goods with American influences. (Cooking, Travel)

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Possessed Toys

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Addams Family Dream Vacation

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Frightening Folklore

programme.title: Halloween Wars - Spine-Chilling Circus

programme.title: The Aging Brain

programme.title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!

programme.title: Food Truck Nation - Burgers, Pizza and Waffles
programme.desc: S1E3 - Making the classic pairing of burger and fries bigger and bolder; jambalaya fries and Hello Burger, an oversized beef patty stuffed with Cajun grilled shrimp; Neapolitan-style pizzas; Belgian waffles topped with cookie butter and whipped cream. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Truck Nation - Stuffed Arepas, Mac 'n' Cheese and Doughnuts
programme.desc: S2E5 - A traditional corn cake sandwich filled with marinated flank steak; grilled pork sausage and creamy avocado sauce; inventive macaroni and cheese; Mac Waffles, a spin on chicken and waffles, with three-cheese macaroni baked in; sweet mini doughnuts. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Truck Nation - Burritos, Kabobs and S'mores
programme.desc: S2E8 - A unique spin on Mexican food by infusing it with the flavors of Korea; a Gogi Bowl and the popular Korean barbecue burrito filled with marinated beef and spicy kimchi fried rice; authentic Persian food; lamb and beef kabob. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Truck Nation - Hot Chicken, Spicy Beef and Ice Cream Sundaes
programme.desc: S2E9 - Brad Miller begins his culinary adventure in Nashville with a take on the local favorite, hot chicken; a food truck delivering authentic Laotian cuisine; green papaya salad and waterfall beef; fry bread taco topped with sausage gravy and a fried egg. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Global Grub
programme.desc: S14E53 - A vast array of global flavors, from fully-loaded Mexican tortas to the cheesiest Greek lasagna. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Neighborhood Hangouts

programme.title: Food Paradise - Seafood -- Eat Food!
programme.desc: S14E37 - Seafood dishes that are making waves with fresh seafood, sandwiches and chowder gravy. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Food Paradise - Food Hall Frenzy
programme.desc: S14E34 - Food halls for gourmet eats on the go; there's gravy-smothered fried chicken biscuits and Vietnamese-Cajun cuisine in New Orleans; both New-York-style pizza and ice cream. (Travel, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Smoked
programme.desc: S3E7 - Roger Mooking crisscrosses America to count down 15 of the best steaks, wings, Reubens and more; salt-cured country ham to smoked fish chowder, bacon bourbon rib-eye steak to smoky s'mores pancakes. (Reality, Cooking)

programme.title: Man's Greatest Food - Fired Up

programme.title: Yum and Yummer - By the Sea

Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Biography, Drama, Historical drama, Movie, Thriller)

The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Kevin Spacey, Jennifer Aniston (Comedy, Crime, Movie)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2

After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Chris Pine (Comedy, Movie)

Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. - Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps, Alfre Woodard, Dennis Haysbert, Debbi Morgan (Comedy, Drama, Movie, Romance)

Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Crime, Drama, Movie)

Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. - Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Brent Briscoe, Bridget Fonda, Jack Walsh (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller)

After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

What begins as a strange ritual quickly unravels into a waking nightmare as she becomes trapped in a terrifying world where reality bends and memory betrays. As time slips away, she must confront the darkness not just around her, but within her, before it consumes everything and everyone she's ever known. - Dakota Fanning, Kathryn Hunter, Mary McCormack, Rachel Blanchard, Devyn Nekoda (Horror, Thriller)

programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds. - Robert Redford, Morgan Freeman, Jennifer Lopez, Becca Gardner, Josh Lucas (Drama)

programme.desc: Framed for the murder of her husband, Libby Parsons (Ashley Judd) survives the long years in prison with two burning desires sustaining her -- finding her son and solving the mystery that destroyed her once-happy life. Standing between her and her quest, however, is her parole officer, Travis Lehman (Tommy Lee Jones). Libby poses a challenge to the cynical officer, one that forces him to face up to his own failings while pitting him against his superiors and law enforcement colleagues. - Tommy Lee Jones, Ashley Judd, Bruce Greenwood, Annabeth Gish, Roma Maffia (Thriller, Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Mystery)

programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. - Renée Zellweger, Colin Firth, Patrick Dempsey, Emma Thompson, Shirley Henderson (Romantic comedy, Drama)

A young Shakespeare is out of cash and ideas; he meets his ideal woman and she inspires him to write one of his most famous plays. - Joseph Fiennes, Gwyneth Paltrow, Geoffrey Rush, Judi Dench, Simon Callow (Romantic comedy)

At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt). - Mel Gibson, Helen Hunt, Marisa Tomei, Mark Feuerstein, Lauren Holly (Romantic comedy)

The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend. - Jack Lemmon, Walter Matthau, Ann-Margret, Daryl Hannah, Buck Henry (Comedy)

Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. - Adam Sandler, Jennifer Aniston, Nicole Kidman, Nick Swardson, Brooklyn Decker (Romantic comedy, Comedy)

Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. - Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Tina Fey, Tim Meadows, Amy Poehler (Comedy)

Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. - Adam Sandler, Drew Barrymore, Christine Taylor, Allen Covert, Matthew Glave (Romantic comedy)

Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart. - Sanaa Lathan, Omar Epps, Alfre Woodard, Dennis Haysbert, Debbi Morgan (Romance, Drama)

Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins. - Juliette Binoche, Johnny Depp, Lena Olin, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina (Drama, Romance)

The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: MLB Central (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Now (Live)
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls. (Baseball)

programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown." (Baseball)

programme.title: MLB Baseball (Live)
programme.desc: Major League Baseball. (Classic sport event, Baseball)

programme.title: Intentional Talk (Live)
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media. (Baseball)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Shell
programme.desc: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake gets drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon, only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath the seemingly flawless surface. - Elisabeth Moss, Kate Hudson, Arian Moayed, Este Haim, Elizabeth Berkley (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Bleed for This
programme.desc: Vinny "The Pazmanian Devil" Pazienza (Miles Teller), a local Providence boxer, shoots to stardom after winning two world title fights. After a near-fatal car accident leaves him with a broken neck, he is told he may never walk again. Against all odds and doctor's orders, renowned trainer Kevin Rooney (Aaron Eckhart) agrees to help Vinny return to the ring just a year after the accident for what could be the last fight of his life. Based on a true story. - Miles Teller, Aaron Eckhart, Katey Sagal, Ciarán Hinds, Ted Levine (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure. - Michael C. Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (Drama)

programme.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
programme.desc: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. - Frankie Faison, Steve O'Connell, Enrico Natale, Ben Marten, Angela Peel (Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Walking Out
programme.desc: When a city teen travels to Montana to go hunting with his estranged father, the trip becomes a battle for survival when they encounter a grizzly bear. - Matt Bomer, Josh Wiggins, Bill Pullman, Alex Neustaedter, Lily Gladstone (Adventure, Drama)

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Love Me
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love. - Kristen Stewart, Steven Yeun (Romance, Science fiction, Drama)

programme.title: End of Sentence
programme.desc: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland. - John Hawkes, Logan Lerman, Sarah Bolger, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson, Andrea Irvine (Drama)

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love. - Alex Pettyfer, Vanessa Hudgens, Neil Patrick Harris, Peter Krause, LisaGay Hamilton (Fantasy, Romance, Drama)

programme.title: Raging Grace
programme.desc: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart. - Max Eigenmann, Jaeden Boadilla, Leanne Best, David Hayman, Oliver Wellington (Horror, Drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart. - Nicholas Hamilton, Jared Harris, Sasha Bhasin, Will Price, Jamie Harris (Drama)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: They
programme.desc: Julia (Laura Regan), a smart, athletic psychology student is finally starting to get her life together. As a kid she was traumatized by night terrors, but now she is cruising towards a successful career as a psychologist and has a rock solid EMT boyfriend to boot (Marc Blucas). After a friend commits suicide - saying the night terrors have returned - Julia and some of her other friends start to experience the same terrors... - Laura Regan, Marc Blucas, Ethan Embry, Dagmara Dominczyk, Jon Abrahams (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body. - Marlon Wayans, Essence Atkins, Cedric the Entertainer, David Koechner, Nick Swardson (Comedy, Horror)

programme.title: A Haunted House 2

He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go. - Marlon Wayans, Jaime Pressly, Essence Atkins, Gabriel Iglesias, Cedric the Entertainer (Comedy, Horror)

Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. - Jason Bateman, Olivia Munn, T.J. Miller, Jennifer Aniston, Kate McKinnon (Holiday, Comedy)

However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick. - Freddie Highmore, Sarah Bolger, Mary-Louise Parker, David Strathairn, Joan Plowright (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Drama, Action)

A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. - Noah Ringer, Dev Patel, Nicola Peltz, Jackson Rathbone, Shaun Toub (Fantasy, Adventure)

programme.title: Furlough
programme.desc: A young woman works part-time at a prison while also caring for her mother. The rookie guard gets a chance to prove her mettle when she's tasked with accompanying a hell-raising inmate on an emergency furlough to visit her dying mother. But things soon spiral out of control, sending the pair on a surprisingly touching road trip. - Tessa Thompson, Whoopi Goldberg, Melissa Leo, La La Anthony, Drena De Niro (Comedy)

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way. - Dylan O'Brien, Jessica Henwick, Dan Ewing, Michael Rooker, Ariana Greenblatt (Fantasy, Adventure, Comedy)

programme.title: The Longest War

programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister. - Channing Tatum, Alex Pettyfer, Matthew McConaughey, Cody Horn, Olivia Munn (Comedy drama)

As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. - Shirley Henderson, Ciarán Hinds, Allison Janney, Michael Lerner, Chris Marquette (Comedy drama)

programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Cate Blanchett, Kate Beckinsale, John C. Reilly, Alec Baldwin (Biography, Historical drama)

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew. - Ben Affleck, Bryan Cranston, Alan Arkin, John Goodman, Victor Garber (Historical drama, Thriller, Biography)

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Liam Neeson, Jim Broadbent (Historical drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: Se7en
programme.desc: When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city. - Brad Pitt, Morgan Freeman, Gwyneth Paltrow, R. Lee Ermey, Richard Roundtree (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters. - Helen Mirren, Jason Clarke, Sarah Snook, Angus Sampson, Laura Brent (Horror, Thriller, Biography, Drama, Fantasy)

programme.title: Doctor Sleep
programme.desc: Struggling with alcoholism, Dan Torrance remains traumatized by the sinister events that occurred at the Overlook Hotel when he was a child. His hope for a peaceful existence soon becomes shattered when he meets Abra, a teen who shares his extrasensory gift of the "shine." Together, they form an unlikely alliance to battle the True Knot, a cult whose members try to feed off the shine of innocents to become immortal. - Ewan McGregor, Rebecca Ferguson, Kyliegh Curran, Cliff Curtis, Zahn McClarnon (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Crimes of the Future
programme.desc: As the human species adapts to a synthetic environment, the body undergoes new transformations and mutations. Accompanied by his partner, celebrity performance artist Saul Tenser showcases the metamorphosis of his organs. Meanwhile, a mysterious group tries to use Saul's notoriety to shed light on the next phase of human evolution. - Viggo Mortensen, Léa Seydoux, Kristen Stewart, Scott Speedman, Welket Bungué (Horror, Science fiction)

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). - Matthew McConaughey, Emile Hirsch, Juno Temple, Gina Gershon, Thomas Haden Church (Crime drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Joe Dirt
programme.desc: He's the wrong person, at the wrong place, at the wrong time. Joe Dirt (David Spade) is a janitor with a mullet hairdo, acid-washed jeans and a dream -- to find the parents that he lost at the Grand Canyon when he was eight. As his wandering, misguided search takes him from one misadventure to another, he finds his way to Los Angeles, where a shock-jock (Dennis Miller) brings Joe on the radio to insult him. But as Joe's story unfolds, jeers turn to cheers, and an entire city is captivated. - David Spade, Dennis Miller, Brittany Daniel, Kid Rock, Adam Beach (Comedy)

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has. - Ben Milliken, Brad William Henke, Janel Parrish, Mark Dacascos, Celestino Cornielle (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley, Dan Gill, Ivy George (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked. - Matthew Broderick, Reese Witherspoon, Chris Klein, Jessica Campbell, Mark Harelik (Comedy, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights. - Christoph Waltz, Lucy Liu, Cooper Hoffman, Ryan McParland, Ann Akinjirin (Action, Comedy)

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: In this feature film based on the hit animated series, the third-graders of South Park sneak into an R-rated film by ultra-vulgar Canadian television personalities Terrance (Matt Stone) and Phillip (Trey Parker), and emerge with expanded vocabularies that leave their parents and teachers scandalized. When outraged Americans try to censor the film, the controversy becomes a call to war with Canada, and Terrance and Phillip end up on death row -- with only the kids left to save them. (Animated, Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Colin Farrell (Comedy)

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans. - Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis, Jennifer Aniston, Kevin Spacey (Comedy)

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government? - Steve Buscemi, Simon Russell Beale, Jeffrey Tambor, Paddy Considine, Rupert Friend (Dark comedy, Historical drama)

programme.title: Best in Show
programme.desc: The tension is palpable, the excitement is mounting and the heady scent of competition is in the air as hundreds of eager contestants from across America prepare to take part in what is undoubtedly one of the greatest events of their lives -- the Mayflower Dog Show. The canine contestants and their owners are as wondrously diverse as the great country that has bred them. - Michael Hitchcock, Parker Posey, Eugene Levy, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Guest (Comedy, LGBTQ)

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: After discovering his girlfriend has been participating in group sex, attorney Mitch feels his world come undone. He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard. - Luke Wilson, Will Ferrell, Vince Vaughn, Jeremy Piven, Ellen Pompeo (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass 3
programme.desc: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull." (Comedy, Docudrama)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Georgina Cates, Greg Harris, Spike Jonze (Comedy)

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe. - Jessica Chastain, Idris Elba, Michael Cera, Kevin Costner, Jeremy Strong (Biography, Drama)

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother. - Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand, Kate Hudson, Jason Lee, Patrick Fugit (Comedy drama, Music, Rock, Drama)

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: One morning in an ordinary town, five people are shot dead in a seemingly random attack; all evidence points to a single suspect: an ex-military sniper who is quickly brought into custody; Reacher, an enigmatic ex-Army investigator, believes the authorities have the right man but agrees to help the sniper's defense attorney. However, the more Reacher delves into the case, the less clear-cut it appears. - Tom Cruise, Rosamund Pike, Robert Duvall, Richard Jenkins, Werner Herzog (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) springs into action after the arrest of Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), an Army major accused of treason. Suspecting foul play, Jack embarks on a mission to prove that the head of his old unit is innocent. After crossing paths with the law, Reacher must now go on the lam to uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy that involves the death of U.S. soldiers. - Tom Cruise, Cobie Smulders, Aldis Hodge, Danika Yarosh, Patrick Heusinger (Action, Thriller)

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Gas station owner Ray (Rick Cramer) saves an elderly voodoo priestess trapped inside a wrecked car, but then he opens her mysterious suitcase and becomes possessed by the evil spirits it contains. Ray turns into a murderous zombie, killing anything that crosses his path and terrorizing a group of teens, including his own son, Sean (D.J. Cotrona). With the help and charms of the voodoo priestess, Sean and friends fight to stay alive as they are pursued through the bayou. - Agnes Bruckner, Jonathan Jackson, Laura Ramsey, D.J. Cotrona, Rick Cramer (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society. - Ellen Page, Sam Keeley, Tom Vaughan-Lawlor, Stuart Graham, Peter Campion (Horror, Thriller, Drama)

programme.title: Godzilla
programme.desc: Ford Brody (Aaron Taylor-Johnson), a Navy bomb expert, has just reunited with his family in San Francisco when he is forced to go to Japan to help his estranged father, Joe (Bryan Cranston). Soon, both men are swept up in an escalating crisis when Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises from the sea to combat malevolent adversaries that threaten the survival of humanity. The creatures leave colossal destruction in their wake, as they make their way toward their final battleground: San Francisco. - Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ken Watanabe, Elizabeth Olsen, Juliette Binoche, Sally Hawkins (Science fiction, Action, Adventure)

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist. - Elisabeth Shue, Michael Byrne, Phillip Noyce, Val Kilmer (Action)

programme.title: Get Hard
programme.desc: When a rich hedge-fund manager, James, is convicted of fraud and sentenced to a stretch in San Quentin, the judge gives him one month to get his affairs in order. Knowing that he won't survive more than a few minutes in prison on his own, James turns to Darnell, a Black businessman who's never even had a parking ticket, for help. As Darnell puts James through the wringer, both learn that they were wrong about many things, including each other. - Will Ferrell, Kevin Hart, Craig T. Nelson, Alison Brie, Edwina Findley (Comedy)

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series. - Johnny Knoxville, Jackson Nicoll, Greg Harris, Georgina Cates, Kamber Hejlik (Comedy)

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Scientist Karen Ross (Laura Linney) is sent by her father-in-law, mogul R.B. Travis (Joe Don Baker), to the Congo to determine the whereabouts of his son's missing diamond-hunting team. Led by expert guide Kelly (Ernie Hudson), Ross and a mismatched search party -- including primatologist Dr. Peter Elliot (Dylan Walsh), treasure hunter Herkermer Homolka (Tim Curry) and a gorilla -- discover a danger far more sinister than anything they expected to find, even in the heart of the jungle. - Dylan Walsh, Laura Linney, Ernie Hudson, Tim Curry, Grant Heslov (Action, Adventure)

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed. - Kurt Russell, Stacy Keach, Steve Buscemi, Cliff Robertson, Peter Fonda (Action, Adventure, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force. - Chris J. Murray, Brit Shaw, Olivia Taylor Dudley, Dan Gill, Ivy George (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II
programme.desc: Found terrified and alone in rural Louisiana, Nell Sweetzer is now safely in New Orleans. She can't remember the terrible events of the previous months, only that she is the only surviving member of her family. Nell wants to start a new life for herself, but just as she begins the difficult process, the evil force that once possessed her returns -- bringing with it unimaginably horrific plans that mean her last exorcism was just the beginning. - Ashley Bell, Julia Garner, Spencer Treat Clark, Louis Herthum, David Jensen (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Perfect Gamble
programme.desc: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino. - David Arquette, Danny A. Abeckaser, Daniella Pick Tarantino, Dean Miroshnikov, Herzl Tobey (Crime drama)

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice. - Jeff Bridges, Matt Damon, Josh Brolin, Barry Pepper, Hailee Steinfeld (Western, Drama, Adventure)

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: Dr. Ryan Stone is a medical engineer on her first shuttle mission. Her commander is veteran astronaut Matt Kowalski, helming his last flight before retirement. Then, during a routine space walk by the pair, disaster strikes: The shuttle is destroyed, leaving Ryan and Matt stranded in deep space with no link to Earth and no hope of rescue. As fear turns to panic, they realize that the only way home may be to venture further into space. - Sandra Bullock, George Clooney, Adam Cozens (Drama, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A spaceship missing for seven years finally re-emerges and sends out a distress signal. But when a team is sent out to investigate, they discover that something sinister has taken over the craft. - Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson, Richard T. Jones (Science fiction, Horror)

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy. - Gerard Butler, Lena Headey, David Wenham, Dominic West, Rodrigo Santoro (Action, Adventure, Drama, Fantasy, War)

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks. - Charles Esten, Oded Fehr, Brec Bassinger, Joel Johnstone, Lauren Call (Drama)

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food. - Elisabeth Shue, Steven R McQueen, Adam Scott, Jerry O'Connell, Jessica Szohr (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: Spontaneous
programme.desc: When students in their high school inexplicably start to explode, seniors Mara and Dylan struggle to survive in a world where each moment may be their last. As an unexpected romance blossoms between them, they soon discover that when tomorrow is no longer promised, they can finally start living for today. - Katherine Langford, Charlie Plummer, Yvonne Orji, Hayley Law, Rob Huebel (Dark comedy, Horror, Romance)

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them. - Shanti Lowry, Sophia Ali, Andrew Howard, Omar Gooding, Dylan Mooney (Thriller)

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Long ago, Abraham Van Helsing (Christopher Plummer) imprisoned the infamous Count Dracula (Gerard Butler) within a vault inside Carfax Abbey. In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. Liberated from his prison, Dracula seizes the opportunity to escape, but Van Helsing sets out to banish him to the crypt once again. - Christopher Plummer, Gerard Butler, Jonny Lee Miller, Justine Waddell, Jennifer Esposito (Horror, Action, Fantasy, Thriller, Romance)

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin. - Haley Joel Osment, Jude Law, Frances O'Connor, Brendan Gleeson, Sam Robards (Science fiction, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. - Clint Eastwood, Hilary Swank, Morgan Freeman, Anthony Mackie, Jay Baruchel (Drama)

programme.title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: This live action feature is inspired by the most successful interactive video-game character in history -- Lara Croft. Beautiful and brainy, Lara is the heroine of Eidos Interactive's phenomenally successful "Tomb Raider" game series. It is one woman's fearless quest crisscrossing the globe, in an amazing attempt to save the world. - Angelina Jolie, Jon Voight, Iain Glen, Noah Taylor, Daniel Craig (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Thriller)

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: Following the death of Vesper Lynd, James Bond (Daniel Craig) makes his next mission personal. The hunt for those who blackmailed his lover leads him to ruthless businessman Dominic Greene (Mathieu Amalric), a key player in the organization which coerced Vesper. Bond learns that Greene is plotting to gain total control of a vital natural resource, and he must navigate a minefield of danger and treachery to foil the plan. - Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric, Judi Dench, Giancarlo Giannini (Action, Adventure, Thriller)

programme.title: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Amsterdam Vallon (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a young Irish immigrant released from prison. He returns to the Five Points seeking revenge against his father's killer, William Cutting (Daniel Day-Lewis), a powerful anti-immigrant gang leader. He knows that revenge can only be attained by infiltrating Cutting's inner circle. Amsterdam's journey becomes a fight for personal survival and to find a place for the Irish people in the 1860's New York. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Daniel Day-Lewis, Cameron Diaz, Liam Neeson, Jim Broadbent (Historical drama, Crime drama)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated. - Fionn Whitehead, Tom Glynn-Carney, Jack Lowden, Harry Styles, Aneurin Barnard (War, Historical drama, Action)

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator. - Linda Hamilton, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Mackenzie Davis, Natalia Reyes, Gabriel Luna (Science fiction, Action)

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done. - Danny Trejo, Michelle Rodriguez, Sofía Vergara, Amber Heard, Antonio Banderas (Action)

programme.title: Pulp Fiction
programme.desc: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace; his actress wife, Mia; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge; master fixer The Wolf and a nervous pair of armed robbers, Pumpkin and Honey Bunny. - John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman, Harvey Keitel, Tim Roth (Crime drama, Dark comedy)

programme.title: Buddymoon
programme.desc: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon. - David Giuntoli, Flula Borg, Claire Coffee, Brian T. Finney, Jeanne Syquia (Comedy)

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven (Brandon Lee) and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent inner-city gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission. - Brandon Lee, Ernie Hudson, Michael Wincott, David Patrick Kelly, Angel David (Action, Fantasy)

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: When a cockroach-spread plague threatens to decimate the child population of New York City, evolutionary biologist Susan Tyler (Mira Sorvino) and her research associates rig up a species of "Judas" bugs and introduce them into the environment, where they will mimic the diseased roaches and infiltrate their grubby habitats. So far so good ... until the bugs keep on evolving and learn to mimic their next prey -- humans. - Mira Sorvino, Jeremy Northam, Josh Brolin, Giancarlo Giannini, Charles S. Dutton (Horror, Science fiction, Thriller)

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Though well-meaning scientists thought they'd destroyed them all, a single gigantic, murderous Judas Breed cockroach, which is capable of taking on the shape of a human, is still on the loose. When the monster follows entomologist Remi Panos and kills her boyfriend, Jason Mundy, Remi becomes the prime suspect. Assigned to the case, detective Klaski grows convinced of her innocence and soon joins forces with her to hunt down the creature. - Alix Koromzay, Bruno Campos, Will Estes, Joseph Hodge, Jon Polito (Horror, Thriller)

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: In the year 2019, America is a totalitarian state where the favorite television program is "The Running Man" -- a game show in which prisoners must run to freedom to avoid a brutal death. Having been made a scapegoat by the government, an imprisoned Ben Richards (Arnold Schwarzenegger) has the opportunity to make it back to the outside again by being a contestant on the deadly show, although the twisted host, Damon Killian (Richard Dawson), has no intention of letting him escape. - Arnold Schwarzenegger, Maria Conchita Alonso, Richard Dawson, Yaphet Kotto, Jim Brown (Action, Adventure, Science fiction)

programme.title: Jacob's Ladder
programme.desc: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness. - Tim Robbins, Elizabeth Peña, Danny Aiello, Matt Craven, Pruitt Taylor Vince (Horror, Drama, Thriller)

programme.title: A Simple Plan
programme.desc: While in the woods near their small town, upstanding local Hank Mitchell (Bill Paxton), his dim brother Jacob (Billy Bob Thornton) and their friend Lou (Brent Briscoe) discover a crashed plane with two things in it -- a dead pilot, and a stash of more than four million dollars. Although Hank is reluctant to keep the money, Jacob and Lou convince him otherwise, and they devise a plan to split the fortune. Things quickly go wrong, however, dramatically affecting the trio and those around them. - Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Brent Briscoe, Bridget Fonda, Jack Walsh (Thriller, Crime drama)

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival. - Henry Thomas, Bradley Stryker, Jennifer Robertson, Olivia Taylor Dudley, C. Ernst Harth (Thriller)

programme.title: Area 51
programme.desc: Obsessed with UFOs, a man (Reid Warner) and two friends find evidence of an alien presence at Area 51 in Nevada. - Reid Warner, Ben Rovner, Jelena Nik, Roy Abramsohn, Darrin Bragg (Science fiction, Horror, Mystery)

programme.desc: S1E1 - Rinella spends three days alone in the wild hunting for blacktail deer; if he lands one, Rinella plans to use a rock to pound the delicate loin into tender medallions to feast on before the float plane returns. (Outdoors, Hunting, Cooking)

programme.title: The Western Hunter - Barely Legal Part 1
programme.desc: S14E3 - The Western Hunter documents the journeys of public land hunters out West. The stories unfold in some of the most wild and beautiful settings on the continent in pursuit of big game. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Heartland Waterfowl - Oklahoma Showdown
programme.desc: S13E4 - The Award-Winning Heartland Waterfowl is a team of men from the Midwest that travels across the US and Canada to film honest waterfowl hunting experiences. With a variety of personalities, these hunting buddies pursue waterfowl hunting with hard work and a dedication to scouting, while showcasing their efforts with the highest standard of production quality. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Ducks Unlimited - Illinois River Valley Mallards Part 1
programme.desc: S29E4 - Co-Host Fred Zink finds himself in the backwaters of the Illinois River at Rice Pond Preserve with owner Doug Oberhelman and land manager Shawn Herrick. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Whitetail Fix - A Michigan Tank!
programme.desc: S14E4 - Thanks be to God, after a handful of encounters, Ernie finally closes the chapter on a Michigan bully-buck rightly coined Tank. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Roger Raglin Outdoors - The Half Rack Buck
programme.desc: S24E4 - Join host Roger Raglin for one exciting whitetail adventure after another. Roger Raglin Outdoors features all big game but is predominantly whitetail hunting utilizing a variety of hunting methods: bow, rifle and black powder. As a true outdoorsman and an exceptional big game hunter, Roger shares a lifetime of tricks and techniques to help you in your quest for big game. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: The Wild Outdoors - Diamond Springs
programme.desc: Hunting at the Diamond Springs Ranch in Kansas. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Dead Meat - Montana Opener
programme.desc: S6E3 - Leysath receives an invitation from a friend, Vince Crudele, who has relocated to Montana from California. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Trijicon's World of Sports Afield - Dave's Annual Spring Fling
programme.desc: S14E10 - Host Dave Fulson heads to the Texas Hill Country as his good buddy Brian Bannister turns him loose in a Turkey paradise. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Hornady's Dark and Dangerous - Lion Down
programme.desc: S14E4 - Hornady's Dark & Dangerous is a bold series that documents the highs, lows, harsh realities and tangible risks always present on a fair chase, dangerous game safari into wild Africa. This features Africa's most recognized Professional Hunters who allow the Safari Classics camera crew unprecedented access into the world of real-time safari adventure. (Hunting)

programme.title: Army Buck Hunters - Third Sit
programme.desc: S6E9 - With zero saddle-hunting experience, Shawn draws on years of rappelling and airborne experience, unpacks the saddle from the back of the truck, climbs a tree — and on only his third sit, takes his target Alabama buck. (Hunting)

programme.title: Gun Stories - Influential Semiautomatic Pistols Part 1
programme.desc: S10E3 - Joe Mantegna takes a look at some of the most famous semi-automatic pistols ever produced. (Documentary, History)

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Hunting Adventures - The Biggest Moose Jim Has Ever Seen
programme.desc: S8E23 - Jim tries to harvest the biggest moose of his career. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Into High Country - Hunting Big Backcountry Black Bears
programme.desc: S17E10 - Jason and his girlfriend Tara spend the spring trying to turn up two big bears. With only a few days left the couple finds what they have been looking for. (Outdoors)

programme.title: Wild Upland - Utah Waterfowl
programme.desc: S1E4 - Host Kali Parmley joins friends for a unique hunt from Utah's Great Salt Lake; a trumpeter swan tag has everyone joining in to help a young hunter fill it and waterfowl hunting from a beautiful yet threatened ecosystem. (Hunting, Travel)

programme.title: Greg McHale's Wild Yukon - In His Blood: A Sheep Hunt Trilogy - Part 3
programme.desc: S9E4 - After an unsuccessful fall hunt, Greg and Kolter return to the mountains with the family in tow at the start of a new season; with fresh opportunity comes renewed pressure to make it count. (Hunting, Adventure)

programme.title: Huntworx - Seth & Tracy hunt for Missouri Bucks
programme.desc: S4E4 - HuntWorxis a new show based around the ideology of the three major principles that aid in consistently harvesting mature animals. This plan, prep and pursue model has stood the test of time and continues to pay dividends for our cast year in and year out. (Hunting)

programme.title: The Western Hunter - Barely Legal Part 1
programme.desc: S14E3 - The Western Hunter documents the journeys of public land hunters out West. The stories unfold in some of the most wild and beautiful settings on the continent in pursuit of big game. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Ranch America - C-Punch Ranch

programme.title: Everything Eichler - Colorado Waterfowl
programme.desc: S9E19 - Waterfowl hunting in Colorado may surprise you. Colorado is known for world-class big game hunting, but its waterfowl opportunities are just as impressive. (Outdoors)

programme.title: MOJO TV - Cracking Them on Whiskey Creek
programme.desc: S19E22 - Terry and special guests Will and Anse Brantley have a trip to remember at Whiskey Creek Outfitters in Oklahoma. (Outdoors, Hunting)

programme.title: Larry Smith Outdoors - Chasing Big Salmon for Skein

programme.title: Two Conchs Adventures - Deep Dropping Pulley Ridge
programme.desc: S5E4 - Headed out to Pulley Ridge this episode, the crew is hoping to get on some deep drop fishing action. (Fishing, Outdoors)

programme.title: Legends of the Fall - Texas Early Season
programme.desc: S17E4 - Legends of the Fall is produced with truly die-hard deer hunters in mind. programme.title: Priest
programme.desc: In a society ravaged by centuries of war between humans and vampires, a legendary warrior priest (Paul Bettany), a veteran of the last conflict, lives in an enclosed city ruled by the church. When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills. - Paul Bettany, Karl Urban, Cam Gigandet, Maggie Q, Lily Collins (Fantasy, Horror, Action)

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: After newspaper reporter Cindy (Anna Faris) accidentally watches a strange videotape that causes the viewer to die within a week, she discovers the tape is only one of many weird happenings. Local farmers Tom (Charlie Sheen) and George (Simon Rex) have reported massive crop circles appearing overnight in their fields. programme.title: Man of the House
programme.desc: Texas Ranger Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones) follows a strict code of behavior and has no patience for those who don't follow suit. When five cheerleaders -- Anne (Christina Milian), Teresa (Paula Garcés), Evie (Monica Keena), Heather (Vanessa Ferlito) and Barb (Kelli Garner) -- witness a murder, Sharp is assigned to keep them from meeting the same fate. Greenberg, aka "Greeny," is formerly one-half of ESPN Radio's longtime "Mike & Mike" morning show. (Sports talk)

programme.title: NBA Today (Live)
